cards.text: Joshua, Israel's leader, has died (Joshua 24:29), and there are still Canaanites in the land to fight. Somebody has to go first. So the Israelites do the smart thing and ask the LORD who it'll be.

cards.question: The Israelites ask who goes up first against the Canaanites. Which tribe does the LORD pick?
Before a single battle is fought, the LORD says He has already delivered the land into Judah's hands.

cards.text: Then the men of Judah turn to their brothers the Simeonites, another tribe of Israel, with a deal.

cards.question: What deal do the men of Judah offer the Simeonites?

answers.text: Fight with us and we will fight with you
Fight for us and we will pay you well
Guard our land while we go and fight

cards.question: The Simeonites turn down Judah's offer.

cards.text: Then Judah attacks the Canaanites and the Perizzites, another people in the land, and strikes down ten thousand men at Bezek.

cards.question: Judah wins at Bezek by its own strength, without the LORD's help.

cards.text: At Bezek they find a man named Adoni-bezek and fight against him. As he flees, they chase him, seize him and cut off his thumbs and big toes.

cards.question: Adoni-bezek says, “Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have gathered the scraps under my table.” What does he say has happened to him now?

answers.text: God has repaid him for it
His own men have turned on him
His luck has finally run out

cards.text: They bring Adoni-bezek to Jerusalem, and he dies there.

cards.question: Next, the men of Judah fight against Jerusalem and ___ it.

cards.text: They put Jerusalem to the sword and set it on fire. That's a heavy moment, friend, and Judah isn't stopping there.
Next, Judah marches down to fight the Canaanites in the hill country, the Negev and the foothills. That's three places, friend, and I get winded hopping to my SECOND oven.
Judah also marches against the Canaanites living in Hebron, which used to be called Kiriath-arba. There they strike down Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai.
From there, Judah marches on Debir, which used to be called Kiriath-sepher. Then Caleb, a spy who followed the LORD fully back when Moses led Israel (Numbers 13:6; 14:24), makes an announcement.

cards.question: What does Caleb promise the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it?
Somebody takes Caleb up on his offer and captures the city. Who is it?

cards.text: Othniel is the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz, and Caleb gives him his daughter Acsah in marriage. Othniel took a whole city, and the bravest thing I've done lately is eat raw cookie dough.
One day Acsah urges Othniel to ask her father for a field. When she gets off her donkey, Caleb asks her, “What do you desire?”

cards.question: “Give me a blessing,” Acsah answers. Caleb has already given her land in the Negev. What does she ask him to give her as well?
Caleb gives Acsah only the upper springs.

cards.text: Now another group goes up with the men of Judah, from the City of Palms to the Wilderness of Judah in the Negev near Arad. They go to live among the people.

cards.question: A group goes up with the men of Judah from the City of Palms and settles among the people. Who are they?

cards.text: Then Judah teams up with their brothers the Simeonites again, and that partnership from the start is still going strong. Together they attack the Canaanites living in Zephath and devote the city to destruction.

cards.question: After that, Zephath is called by a new name: ___.

cards.text: Judah also captures Gaza, Ashkelon and Ekron, each with its territory. The LORD is with Judah.

cards.question: Judah takes possession of the hill country.
Judah takes the hill country, but not the plains. Why can't Judah drive out the people living in the plains?

answers.text: Judah has run out of men

cards.question: Just as Moses had promised, Judah gives Hebron to ___.
In Hebron, Caleb drives out the descendants of the three sons of Anak.

cards.text: Pull this tray out for now, friend, but don't take that apron off. This story is still baking.
